```{r}
sig_summary <- function(df, threshold=0.05, stat="num") {
  x <- df %>% filter(adj.P.Val < threshold) %>% pull(logFC)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (stat == "num") {
    return(c("all" = length(x), "neg" = sum(x < 0), "pos" = sum(x > 0)))
  } else {
    return(c("all" = length(x)/nrow(df), "neg" = sum(x < 0)/nrow(df), "pos" = sum(x > 0)/nrow(df)))
  }
}
```

```{r}
probe_group_stats <- function(top_list, group="region", stat="num") {
  if (group == "region") {
    df <- cbind(top_list,
                filtered_probe_info[match(rownames(top_list), filtered_probe_info$probe_id),]) %>%
      mutate(region=ifelse(str_detect(region, "exon_") & region != "exon_1",
                          "exon_2+", region)) %>%
      group_by(region)
  }
  if (group == "regulatory_feature_group") {
    df <- cbind(top_list,
                filtered_probe_info[match(rownames(top_list), filtered_probe_info$probe_id),]) %>%
      group_by(regulatory_feature_group)
  }
  if (stat == "num") {
    df <- df %>% summarise(n=n(), 
                     n_sig=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05),
                     n_up=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0),
                     n_down=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0))
  }
  if (stat == "prop") {
    df <- df %>% summarise(n=n(), 
                     n_sig=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05),
                     n_up=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0),
                     n_down=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0)) %>%
      mutate(p_sig=n_sig/n,
             p_up=n_up/n_sig,
             p_down=n_down/n_sig) %>%
      select(-starts_with("n_"))
  }
  return(df)
}
```


```{r}
probe_region_sig <- function(top_list, region_order) {
  df <- cbind(top_list,
              filtered_probe_info[match(rownames(top_list), filtered_probe_info$probe_id),]) %>%
    mutate(region=ifelse(str_detect(region, "exon_") & region != "exon_1",
                         "exon_2+", region)) %>%
    group_by(region) %>% 
    summarise(n=n(), 
              n_sig=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05),
              n_not_sig=sum(adj.P.Val >= 0.05),
              n_up=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0),
              n_down=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0))
    total_sig <- sum(df$n_sig)
    df <- df %>% mutate(p_n=n/nrow(top_list),
           p_sig=n_sig/total_sig,
           p_up=n_up/total_sig,
           p_down=n_down/total_sig) %>%
    select(-starts_with("n_"))
  df <- df[match(region_order, df$region),]
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
plot_probe_region_sig <- function(top_list, region_order) {
  df <- probe_region_sig(top_list, region_order)
  
  dat <- pivot_longer(df, cols=starts_with("p"), names_to="subgroup", values_to="prop") %>%
    select(-n) %>%
    # filter(subgroup != "p_sig") %>%
    mutate(group=ifelse(subgroup != "p_n", "Significant sites", "All analysed sites")) %>%
    mutate(p=prop * 100)
  
  # Kinda hacky... instead of plotting p_up and p_down, plot p_sig and p_down with p_down on top of p_sig
  dat <- dat %>% 
    filter(subgroup != "p_up") %>%
    mutate(subgroup = case_when(
      subgroup == "p_n" ~ "Analysed sites",
      subgroup == "p_down" ~ "Significant hypomethylated sites",
      TRUE ~ "Significant hypermethylated sites"
    ))
  dat$region <- factor(dat$region, levels=region_order)
  
  g <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=region, y=p, fill=subgroup, group=group)) +
    geom_histogram(stat="identity", position="dodge") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x="Genomic Region", y="Methylation Sites (%)") +
    theme(legend.title=element_blank(),
          panel.grid=element_blank())
  return(g)
}
```

```{r}
probe_island_sig <- function(top_list, island_order) {
  df <- cbind(top_list,
              filtered_probe_info[match(rownames(top_list), filtered_probe_info$probe_id),]) %>%
    group_by(island) %>% 
    summarise(n=n(), 
              n_sig=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05),
              n_not_sig=sum(adj.P.Val >= 0.05),
              n_up=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0),
              n_down=sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0))
    total_sig <- sum(df$n_sig)
    df <- df %>% mutate(p_n=n/nrow(top_list),
           p_sig=n_sig/total_sig,
           p_up=n_up/total_sig,
           p_down=n_down/total_sig) %>%
    select(-starts_with("n_"))
  df <- df[match(island_order, df$island),]
  return(df)
}
```


```{r}
plot_probe_island_sig <- function(top_list, island_order) {
  df <- probe_island_sig(top_list, island_order)
  
  dat <- pivot_longer(df, cols=starts_with("p"), names_to="subgroup", values_to="prop") %>%
    select(-n) %>%
    # filter(subgroup != "p_sig") %>%
    mutate(group=ifelse(subgroup != "p_n", "Significant sites", "All analysed sites")) %>%
    mutate(p=prop * 100)
  
  # Kinda hacky... instead of plotting p_up and p_down, plot p_sig and p_down with p_down on top of p_sig
  dat <- dat %>% 
    filter(subgroup != "p_up") %>%
    mutate(subgroup = case_when(
      subgroup == "p_n" ~ "Analysed sites",
      subgroup == "p_down" ~ "Significant hypomethylated sites",
      TRUE ~ "Significant hypermethylated sites"
    ))
  dat$island <- factor(dat$island, levels=island_order)
  
  g <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=island, y=p, fill=subgroup, group=group)) +
    geom_histogram(stat="identity", position="dodge") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x="Methylation site region", y="Methylation Sites (%)") +
    theme(legend.title=element_blank(),
          panel.grid=element_blank())
  return(g)
}
```

# DMR


```{r}
pheno <- rwh_pheno %>%
  mutate(age_scaled=scale(age)[,1]) %>%
  mutate(cycle=case_when(
    time < 9 | time > 99 ~ "men",
    time < 59 ~ "pro",
    TRUE ~ "sec"
  ))  %>% 
  filter(! is.na(ever_pregnant)) %>%
  mutate(group=paste0(cycle, "_", ever_pregnant))
```

```{r}
X <- cSplineDes(pheno$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=4))[,-3]
```

```{r}
f <- as.formula(formula)
design <- model.matrix(f, pheno)
# head(design)
```

### Ever pregnant

```{r}
myannotation <- cpg.annotate("array", object=m_values[,pheno$sample_id], 
                             what = "M", arraytype = "EPICv1", analysis.type="differential",
                             design=design, coef="ever_pregnant", fdr=0.01)
dmr_ever_pregnant <- dmrcate(myannotation, lambda=1000, C=2)
dmr_ever_pregnant_ranges <- extractRanges(dmr_ever_pregnant, genome = "hg19")
```


```{r}
dmr_ever_pregnant_ranges %>% head()
```

```{r}
dmr_ever_pregnant_ranges@seqnames %>% length
```

```{r}
out_df <- as.data.frame(dmr_ever_pregnant_ranges)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(dmr_ever_pregnant_ranges, file=paste(cache_dir, analysis_name, "_dmr_ever_pregnant_ranges.rds", sep=""))
write.table(out_df, file=paste(output_dir, analysis_name, "_dmr_ever_pregnant_ranges.tsv", sep=""),
            row.names=FALSE, sep="\t", quote=FALSE)
```
